player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''jade''') posted a [[Light]] [[Echo Base Operations]] list on DeckTech in December 2000.
description: EBO deck that uses X-Wings to control space and drain. And spies with undercover to cancel force drains.
cards: posted: Red Leader In Red One
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Qty 62 as published (no section counts given).

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker), Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker), The Signal ('The Singal') and A New Secret Base. No objective; the first starting location is set as the starting card. Several cards start, so no starting Effect or Interrupt is set.

Posted 'EPP Luke' dested Luke With Lightsaber; 'Cracken' Colonel Cracken (Death Star II, the only Light Cracken in the 2000 pool); 'Jerome Webb' Jeroen Webb; 'Figirin D'an' Figrin D'an; 'Red Leader In Red One' Red Leader In Red 1; 'X-Wing Cannon' X-wing Laser Cannon.

Posted 'Hoth War Room' dested Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); 'Hoth Docking Bay' Hoth: Echo Docking Bay; 'Hoth Med Lab' Hoth: Echo Med Lab; 'EBO' the Hoth Effect Echo Base Operations; Kiffex is the Light Jabba's Palace system.
Posted 'Wise Advise' dested the Special Edition Effect Wise Advice; 'Honar Of The Jedi' Honor Of The Jedi; 'Docking And Repair Facilitys' Docking And Repair Facilities.
The author's note (take out 1 It Could Be Worse, add a Rebel Fleet) is not applied; dested as posted.
